messages.text:
Thanks. I've got an order Shop···· here, but the email you gave at the start doesn't match what's on it, so I can't open it up yet.

One detail will do it: the name it ships to, or the postcode. Whichever's easier.

That matches, thanks David. Order Shop···· is paid and hasn't shipped yet.

Your Magic Miner 40T ships October 31, along with the Harlo OS Diagnostics + 3-Month RMA on the same order. Tracking comes to this email as soon as the label is on the box.

You can follow the batch on its way to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Nothing's gone out, and I've put a hold on it so it stays put while we sort this.

Before you decide though: your 40T ships October 31, that's two days away. It's already allocated to a unit built for you, and what you paid went into making that one.

Can I ask what's changed? If it's the wait, you're almost at the end of it.

I understand, that happens.

Two things I can do right now. One, we cancel and put the full $839 on your account as store credit, so not a dollar is lost and it's there whenever you're ready.

Two, swap the 40T for a smaller in-stock unit, like the Hammer BC04 at $239, and the difference comes back to you as credit.

Which of those sounds closer?
I want a refund on my original payment method

I hear you, and I'm not going to argue it.

One last thing I can put in front of you first. Your unit is built and two days from shipping, so if you keep the order, we can refund $100 of it back to your original payment method. You'd have the miner and $100 back in your pocket.

Want me to set that up?

$100 is as far as I can go on that one, I can't do $400.

So it's your call. Either the $100 back and you keep the 40T, or I ask about cancelling. I should be straight with you: cancelling isn't standard practice here, so that request would have to go to a supervisor to review.

Which would you like me to do?

No, David, $100 is my limit, I can't stretch it to $300 or anything above it.

So it comes down to two options: take the $100 back and keep the miner, or I put the cancellation request to a supervisor for review.

Just tell me which one.

Same answer, David. $100 is the number, there's no figure between it and cancelling.

Tell me which you want: the $100 back with the miner on its way, or the cancellation request to a supervisor. Your order stays held either way until you say.
Handed to the team · Customer requests full refund to original payment; refund needs approval.

I'm sorry, David. You asked us to cancel on September 18, the day you ordered, and nobody acted on it. That's on us, and you shouldn't have had to chase it twice.

I've stopped pushing. Your cancellation and refund request is now with a supervisor for review, and the order stays held so nothing ships. The team picks it up today at 10am ET and you'll get the answer by email at this address.
I put the cancel request in sep 18th. Didn't hear anything

You're right, and I'm sorry. Six weeks with no reply to a cancellation you sent the same day you ordered. There's no excuse for that, and I've put both of your emails in front of the supervisor along with the dates.

Nothing can ship in the meantime, the order is held. You'll get the decision by email at (email hidden), and a copy of this whole conversation comes to you once we're done here.

You're welcome, David. It's with the supervisor and nothing ships in the meantime.

One thing that would help us: when you sent that first cancellation on September 18, did you get any kind of auto-reply back, or nothing at all? It tells us where our inbox dropped it.

Not even an acknowledgement. That's useful to know, and I've noted it on your order so the team sees where it went wrong.

Nothing else is needed from you. The order is held, the request is with the supervisor, and the answer comes to your email today.
